metadata.title: Insights — Fyxio
metadata.description: Insights on better website projects — pricing, ownership, launch, and modern web tools.

sections.heroSub: Most website problems start before design. They start with unclear ownership, weak materials, bloated setups, and messy launch processes.

articles.title: WordPress vs a modern website setup: which one actually makes sense?
articles.excerpt: WordPress is not automatically the right answer for every business website. In some cases it is useful. In others, it adds more maintenance than the business really needs.

articles.title: How much does a business website cost?
articles.excerpt: Website pricing varies because not all projects are solving the same problem. A simple brochure site is very different from a custom redesign with migration work.

articles.title: How to launch a website properly.
articles.excerpt: For many businesses, the website itself is not the hard part — the launch is. Hosting, domain settings, DNS changes, redirects, and final checks are where confusion typically starts.

articles.title: Who should own your domain, hosting, and website code?
articles.excerpt: A lot of website problems are not design problems — they are ownership problems. Businesses often do not know who controls the domain, where the site is hosted, or how it could be moved.

articles.title: How to prepare materials for a website project.
articles.excerpt: Many website projects slow down because the materials are scattered, incomplete, or constantly changing. A well-prepared content folder can save days of unnecessary back-and-forth.
